children: Tesla ( TSLA ) shares climbed about 1% Friday morning as a broader move into consumer-discretionary stocks lifted automakers, while a new electric-truck charging agreement provided a fresh company-specific development.

Tesla said it will operate public Megacharging locations at three electric-truck depots being developed by Forum Mobility in California. The sites will add a combined 30 megawatts of charging capacity and use Tesla's Megawatt Charging System alongside CCS connectors.

The Tesla stock move also came as investors rotated toward cyclical companies. General Motors, Ford and Stellantis all gained on Thursday, while the consumer-discretionary ETF rose faster than the broader S&P 500, suggesting the advance was partly tied to sector-wide buying rather than a single Tesla catalyst.
Broader market conditions were supportive as well. Oil prices fell about 2%, while the 10-year Treasury yield declined, helping ease pressure on equities.
Tesla's gain therefore reflects both the new charging-network development and the wider rebound across consumer and automotive stocks.

title: What's Going On With Tesla Stock Friday
